title:
17
  O NMR spectroscopy in polyoxometalate chemistry: advances, challenges, and applications in structure and catalysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6562-6594
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08401F, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thompson Izuagie, Daniel Lebbie
Advances in high-field, MAS and DNP-enhanced 17O NMR enable direct, site-resolved probing of oxygen in polyoxometalates. Integration with DFT and emerging AI tools reveals new mechanistic insight into structure, protonation and redox catalysis.
